clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint connects sailors with travelers bound across the sea. He is a seasoned human mariner and crew member of the Maiden's Virtue, helping travelers find passage and contacts toward Kalimdor.

Red Jack Flint is a seasoned sailor in Menethil Keep. A crewman of the Maiden's Virtue, he knows the sea routes from Khaz Modan to distant shores. He also directs capable travelers to allies across the Great Sea, including Fiora Longears in Kalimdor.
